title: Metacognitive Scaffolds Create Productive Friction for AI-Assisted Knowledge Work
title_zh: 元认知支架为AI辅助知识工作创造生产性摩擦

paragraphs.en: Generative AI imposes new metacognitive demands on knowledge workers as their work shifts from production to planning, evaluation, and orchestration. In a randomized, between-subjects experiment on AI-assisted writing (297 workers, 594 essays), we test dynamically-generated metacognitive scaffolds supporting goal specification and task decomposition. We find that scaffolds improve writing quality, with this boost persisting in short-lag transfer when scaffolds are removed. We also find evidence of improved topic recall three days later. These effects are consistent with observed changes in how people learn to prompt AI systems after exposure to scaffolding. However, scaffolded participants rate the AI as less helpful and more cognitively demanding even as they perform better, suggesting that subjective ease can understate the value of support. Our findings make the case for metacognitive scaffolds in AI-assisted knowledge work, revealing a productive friction worth designing for as workers increasingly delegate work to agentic AI.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式AI给知识工作者带来了新的元认知要求，因为他们的工作正从生产转向规划、评估与编排。 在一项关于AI辅助写作的随机被试间实验（297名工作者，594篇文章）中，我们测试了动态生成的元认知支架，以支持目标设定与任务分解。 我们发现支架能够提升写作质量，且在支架移除后的短延迟迁移中，这种提升依然持续。 我们还发现了三天后主题回忆能力有所改善的证据。 这些效应与人们在接触支架后学习如何向AI系统提问（prompt）时观察到的变化相一致。 然而，接受支架的被试尽管表现更好，却认为AI帮助较小、认知负担更重，这表明主观的轻松感可能低估了支持的价值。 我们的研究结果为AI辅助知识工作中的元认知支架提供了依据，揭示了随着工作者日益将工作委托给智能体AI，一种值得为之设计的“有益摩擦”。

paragraphs.en: Generative AI (hereafter, AI) is rapidly reshaping knowledge workflows across professional, educational, and creative settings. Increasing experimental evidence demonstrates that access to large language models (LLMs) can raise both productivity and output quality for tasks such as writing, analysis, and problem-solving ( Brynjolfsson et al., 2025 ; Noy and Zhang, 2023 ; Dell’Acqua et al., 2023 ; Dillon et al., 2025b ; Dillon et al., 2025a ) . Yet these gains come with a fundamental shift in the nature of human contribution: rather than executing work directly, the human role increasingly centers on steering and orchestrating model behavior, including specifying goals, decomposing tasks, and evaluating generated output ( Sarkar, 2023 ; Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ; Palani and Ramos, 2024 ; He et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Nguyen et al., 2024 ; Lo, 2023 ; Kasneci et al., 2023 ) . This redistribution of effort imposes metacognitive demands on people that are poorly supported by current AI interfaces ( Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ; Subramonyam et al., 2024 ) . Accordingly, many workers struggle with adopting AI tools or use them ineffectively, slowing their workflows or hampering output quality ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Dell’Acqua et al., 2023 ) . Metacognitive demands intensify further as AI systems become more agentic, with autonomous systems executing multi-step plans, invoking tools, and iterating towards goals on workers’ behalf ( Sarkar, 2026 ; Passi, 2025 ; Dhanorkar et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 生成式人工智能（以下简称 AI）正在迅速重塑专业、教育和创意场景中的知识工作流程。 越来越多的实验证据表明，使用大型语言模型（LLM）可以提升写作、分析和问题解决等任务的生产力与产出质量（ Brynjolfsson et al., 2025 ; Noy and Zhang, 2023 ; Dell’Acqua et al., 2023 ; Dillon et al., 2025b ; Dillon et al., 2025a ）。 然而，这些收益伴随着人类贡献性质的根本转变：人类的角色不再直接执行工作，而是日益聚焦于引导和编排模型行为，包括设定目标、分解任务以及评估模型生成的输出（ Sarkar, 2023 ; Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ; Palani and Ramos, 2024 ; He et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Nguyen et al., 2024 ; Lo, 2023 ; Kasneci et al., 2023 ）。 这种努力的重新分配对人提出了元认知方面的要求，而当前的 AI 界面对此支持不足（ Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ; Subramonyam et al., 2024 ）。 因此，许多工作者难以采用 AI 工具，或使用效果不佳，从而拖慢了工作流程或损害了产出质量（ Lee et al., 2025 ; Dell’Acqua et al., 2023 ）。 随着 AI 系统日益智能体化，元认知要求进一步加剧：自主智能体系统会执行多步计划、调用工具，并代表工作者朝目标持续迭代（ Sarkar, 2026 ; Passi, 2025 ; Dhanorkar et al., 2026 ）。

paragraphs.en: Alongside these challenges of steering and orchestration, using AI increasingly entails offloading material production to the model itself. Workers may no longer write sentences, generate code, or produce other artifacts directly, a shift demonstrated in both experimental and observational studies ( Shaw and Nave, 2026 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026a ) . Consequently, insufficient support for these processes risks not only poorer steering of AI systems, but also reduced cognitive engagement with the work itself.
paragraphs.zh: 在应对这些引导与编排方面的挑战的同时，使用 AI 也日益意味着将实质性生产工作转交给模型本身。 工作者可能不再直接撰写句子、生成代码或制作其他制品，实验性研究和观察性研究都展示了这一转变（Shaw and Nave, 2026; Lee et al., 2025; Kim et al., 2026a）。 如果工作者越来越多地为 AI 设定目标或进行任务分解，那么从定义上看，这些元认知过程就成为工作者参与并理解自身工作的关键部分。 因此，对这些过程的支持不足，不仅可能导致对 AI 系统的引导变差，还可能削弱工作者对工作本身的认知参与。

paragraphs.en: Recent research has begun to address this by exploring AI interfaces that scaffold the articulation of evolving goals ( Kim et al., 2026b ; Gmeiner et al., 2025a ; Drosos et al., 2025 ) , tracking goals across conversations ( Coscia et al., 2025 ) , decomposing tasks into sub-tasks ( Yen et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Kazemitabaar et al., 2024b ; Drosos et al., 2025 ) , and other metacognitive processes important for human-AI interaction. Yet despite this progress, prior work has primarily examined proximal interaction outcomes, such as usability and model steerability. Value in knowledge work depends on more distal outcomes, including output quality, whether benefits persist in the short or long term once support is removed, and cognitive engagement with the work itself. We make progress on all three.
paragraphs.zh: 最近的研究已开始解决这一问题，方法是探索能够辅助表达不断演变目标的 AI 界面（Kim et al., 2026b; Gmeiner et al., 2025a; Drosos et al., 2025）、跨对话追踪目标（Coscia et al., 2025）、将任务分解为子任务（Yen et al., 2024; Feng et al., 2026; Kazemitabaar et al., 2024b; Drosos et al., 2025），以及对人机交互重要的其他元认知过程。 然而尽管有这些进展，先前的工作主要考察的是近端的交互结果，例如可用性和模型可控性。 知识工作的价值取决于更远端的结果，包括产出质量、在支持移除后收益能否在短期或长期内持续，以及对工作本身的认知投入。 我们在这三方面都取得了进展。

paragraphs.en: We present a randomized between-subjects experiment in AI-assisted writing (297 participants, 594 essays), evaluating the impact of metacognitive scaffolding on multiple outcomes key to AI-assisted knowledge work: output quality, prompting ability, cognitive load, and topic recall of work material, as one key aspect of cognitive engagement. We focus on goal specification and task decomposition as the primary targets for metacognitive scaffolding. These processes sit at the beginning of AI-assisted workflows and are therefore key for human-GenAI interaction, as the quality of goal specification and task structure determines how effectively all downstream activities can proceed ( Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ; Tankelevitch and Rintel, 2026 ) . As such, we implemented metacognitive scaffolds as AI-generated, context-specific interface controls for goal specification and task decomposition (the interface and interaction sequence are described in Section 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在AI辅助写作领域开展了一项随机化被试间实验（297名参与者，594篇文章），评估元认知支架对AI辅助知识工作中多项关键结果的影响：产出质量、提示词编写能力、认知负荷，以及作为认知投入关键维度之一的工作材料主题回忆。 我们将目标设定和任务分解作为元认知支架的主要着力点。 这些过程处于AI辅助工作流程的开端，因此是人机（生成式AI）交互的关键，因为目标设定和任务结构的质量决定了后续所有活动能否有效推进（Tankelevitch et al., 2024; Tankelevitch and Rintel, 2026）。 因此，我们将元认知支架实现为针对目标设定和任务分解、由AI生成的情境化界面控件（界面与交互序列见第3.2节）。

paragraphs.en: We first compare the scaffolds’ impact on written output quality, cognitive load, and other aspects of user experience to a baseline interface without scaffolds. Unlike prior work, we then test whether the scaffolds’ impact on human-AI interaction persists into short-lag transfer when support is removed. That is, in a subsequent writing task in the same session where we remove the scaffolds, we evaluate how scaffold exposure affects written output quality and prompting behavior. Finally, to test one aspect of how scaffolds affect cognitive engagement with task material, we follow up with participants three days later to assess their topic recall for both writing tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先将脚手架对书面输出质量、认知负荷以及用户体验其他方面的影响，与无脚手架的基线界面进行比较。 与以往工作不同，我们随后检验脚手架对人机交互的影响是否会在移除支持后的短延迟迁移中持续存在。 也就是说，在同一会话中随后的一个移除脚手架的写作任务里，我们评估接触脚手架如何影响书面输出质量和提示行为。 最后，为检验脚手架影响对任务材料认知投入的一个方面，我们在三天后对参与者进行随访，以评估他们对两个写作任务的话题回忆情况。

paragraphs.en: We find that metacognitive scaffolding improves AI-assisted output quality, helping participants produce written outputs that are more actionable, better organized, and more clearly framed for the task. This effect persists after removal of support. We also find that participants learn to prompt the AI toward clearer goals and stronger task decomposition, offering a potential explanation for this carryover effect. Finally, we find evidence for improved topic recall. However, all of these gains carry a subjective cost: despite better performance, scaffolded participants rate the AI as less helpful and report an increase in immediate post-task cognitive load. We argue that this productive friction —support that increases felt effort and dampens perceived helpfulness while improving outcomes—is a crucial challenge in designing AI systems for knowledge work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，元认知脚手架提升了AI辅助输出的质量，帮助参与者产出更具可操作性、组织更良好、且更清晰贴合任务框架的书面成果。 这种效果在移除支持后依然持续。 我们还发现，参与者学会了通过提示引导AI朝向更清晰的目标和更强的任务分解，这为这种迁移效应提供了一种可能的解释。 最后，我们发现了主题记忆得到改善的证据。 然而，所有这些收益都伴随着主观代价：尽管表现更好，接受脚手架支持的参与者对AI帮助性的评价更低，并报告任务后即时的认知负荷有所增加。 我们认为，这种「有效摩擦」——即提升感受到的努力、降低感知到的帮助性、同时又改善结果的支持——是设计面向知识工作的AI系统时的一项关键挑战。

sents.en: Finally, we find evidence for improved topic recall.

sents.en: However, all of these gains carry a subjective cost: despite better performance, scaffolded participants rate the AI as less helpful and report an increase in immediate post-task cognitive load.
sents.zh: 然而，所有这些收益都伴随着主观代价：尽管表现更好，接受脚手架支持的参与者对AI帮助性的评价更低，并报告任务后即时的认知负荷有所增加。

sents.en: We argue that this productive friction —support that increases felt effort and dampens perceived helpfulness while improving outcomes—is a crucial challenge in designing AI systems for knowledge work.
sents.zh: 我们认为，这种「有效摩擦」——即提升感受到的努力、降低感知到的帮助性、同时又改善结果的支持——是设计面向知识工作的AI系统时的一项关键挑战。

paragraphs.en: We show that dynamic metacognitive scaffolding improves writing quality and prompt quality, and is associated with improved topic recall, and that these improvements survive short-lag transfer when scaffolds are removed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，动态元认知支架能提升写作质量和提示质量，并与话题回忆能力的提升相关，且这些提升在移除支架后仍能在短延迟迁移中得以保持。

paragraphs.en: We find that the benefits of dynamic metacognitive scaffolding come with key trade-offs against perceived cognitive load and helpfulness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，动态元认知脚手架带来的收益在对认知负荷感知和帮助感知方面存在关键权衡。

paragraphs.en: We offer research and design implications for advancing the development of metacognitive support for AI-assisted knowledge work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为推进 AI 辅助知识工作中元认知支持的发展提供了研究与设计方面的启示。

paragraphs.en: Generative AI has rapidly diffused through knowledge work ( Bick et al., 2026 ) . Across a representative sample of ChatGPT conversations, practical guidance, information seeking and writing account for nearly 80% of use, and writing dominates work-related messages ( Chatterji et al., 2025 ) ; similar patterns occur across millions of enterprise Microsoft Copilot Chat ( Counts et al., 2026 ) and Claude conversations ( Handa et al., 2025 ) . This applicability is broad but shallow, concentrated in creating, processing and communicating information rather than end-to-end automation ( Tomlinson et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Controlled experiments across various professions find that LLM access cut writing time and raised quality among professionals ( Noy and Zhang, 2023 ) , accelerated customer support resolutions ( Brynjolfsson et al., 2025 ) , and increased completed programming tasks ( Cui et al., 2026 ) . The gains are uneven, falling away beyond a “jagged frontier” of suitable tasks ( Dell’Acqua et al., 2023 ) , and their distribution across expertise depends on the tool, with different studies finding largest gains among less experienced workers ( Brynjolfsson et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Cruces et al., 2026 ) , more experienced workers ( Daniotti et al., 2026 ) , and contradictory effects between perception and reality ( Becker et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 针对多种职业的受控实验发现，使用大语言模型缩短了专业人士的写作时间并提升了写作质量（Noy and Zhang, 2023），加快了客户支持问题的解决速度（Brynjolfsson et al., 2025），并增加了完成的编程任务数量（Cui et al., 2026）。 这些收益并不均衡，在超出适合任务范围的“参差边界”之后便会消失（Dell'Acqua et al., 2023），且收益在不同专业水平人群中的分布取决于所用工具：不同研究发现收益最大的人群分别是经验较少的工作者（Brynjolfsson et al., 2025；Cui et al., 2026；Cruces et al., 2026）、经验较丰富的工作者（Daniotti et al., 2026），以及在感知与现实之间存在相互矛盾的效果（Becker et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: In some cases the composition of work changes, and in others simply the volume of work, depending on what the tool does. A two-year study of inline code completion found developers shifting activity toward core coding and away from non-core project management, interpreted as a move from collaborative toward independent work ( Hoffmann et al., 2025 ) . That reallocation runs between joint and solo work rather than between producing and directing. Nor does reallocation follow automatically from access: a large-scale field experiment among knowledge workers found time savings without detectable task recomposition ( Dillon et al., 2025a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在某些情况下，工作的构成发生了变化；而在另一些情况下，只是工作量发生了变化，具体取决于工具的功能。 一项关于行内代码补全的为期两年的研究发现，开发者的活动从非核心的项目管理转向核心编码，这被解读为从协作性工作向独立性工作的转变（Hoffmann et al., 2025）。 这种再分配发生在共同工作与独立工作之间，而不是发生在生产与指导之间。 这种再分配也不会随着工具使用权限的获得而自动发生：一项针对知识工作者的大规模现场实验发现，虽然有节省时间的效果，却未检测到任务的重新构成（Dillon et al., 2025a）。

paragraphs.en: Where the model produces the entire artifact rather than completing small portions, however, the axis itself changes. Conceptually, the shift has been described as one from material production to critical integration ( Sarkar, 2023 ) . Where automation can be applied within a workflow influences which forms of human contribution are considered most valuable. In this framing, people contribute primarily by specifying objectives, planning work, selecting and combining outputs, and critically evaluating what the model provides. This shift raises obvious questions about people’s cognitive engagement with their work: what is offloaded and what cognitive tasks remain essential, or become more important, for AI-assisted work? We discuss each in turn.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当模型产出整个作品而非完成其中的一小部分时，这个维度本身也随之改变。 在概念上，这种转变被描述为从物质生产到批判性整合的转变（Sarkar, 2023）。 自动化可以应用在工作流中的哪些环节，会影响哪些形式的人类贡献被认为最有价值。 在这一框架下，人们的贡献主要体现为设定目标、规划工作、选择和组合输出结果，以及对模型所提供的内容进行批判性评估。 这种转变引出了关于人们对工作的认知投入的明显问题：在AI辅助的工作中，哪些内容被卸载了，哪些认知任务仍然不可或缺，或者变得更加重要？我们将依次讨论这两点。

paragraphs.en: Delegating production to AI can entail cognitive offloading : recruiting external resources to reduce a task’s cognitive demands ( Risko and Gilbert, 2016 ) . Prior research has found that among knowledge workers, greater confidence in AI was associated with less perceived effort for critical thinking, and the remaining effort shifted from producing information toward verifying and integrating it ( Lee et al., 2025 ) . Workers may not notice that such offloading is happening. They may misjudge the division of labour: in real world task-focused conversation logs, the model is credited with 11-26% of ‘goal-shaping’ contributions, revealing an over-estimation in users of their own contributions ( Kim et al., 2026a ) . They may also misjudge the result’s quality: across studies, participants tend to over-rely on AI assistance, inappropriately adopting its output with little scrutiny, while gaining self-confidence ( Shaw and Nave, 2026 ; Colombatto et al., 2025 ; Fernandes et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 将生产工作委托给 AI 可能意味着认知卸载：即调用外部资源来降低任务的认知需求（Risko and Gilbert, 2016）。 已有研究发现，在知识工作者中，对 AI 的信心越强，批判性思维所感知到的付出就越少，而剩余的付出则从生成信息转向验证和整合信息（Lee et al., 2025）。 工作者可能没有意识到这种卸载正在发生。 他们可能误判劳动分工：在现实世界中以任务为中心的对话记录中，模型被认为贡献了 11-26% 的「目标塑造」内容，这揭示出用户高估了自己的贡献（Kim et al., 2026a）。 他们也可能误判结果的质量：多项研究表明，参与者往往过度依赖 AI 的辅助，不加仔细审视就不适当地采纳其输出，同时却增强了自信心（Shaw and Nave, 2026; Colombatto et al., 2025; Fernandes et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has begun to measure the effects of offloading. Across recent large field studies of students, AI assistance tended to improve performance when available, e.g., during homework or non-proctored tests, but impaired performance when withdrawn, such as in closed-book exams ( Bastani et al., 2025 ; Strömberg et al., 2026 ; Rismanchian et al., 2026 ) . Similar effects appear for memory of authorship ( Zindulka et al., 2026 ) , for metacognitive accuracy ( Fernandes et al., 2026 ; Marcoccia et al., 2026 ) , and for professional skill such as clinical diagnostic detection ( Budzyń et al., 2025 ) . Such erosion can be asymptomatic: in one high-stakes workplace, early operational gains masked a dulling of expert judgment that only later surfaced as skill atrophy ( Ehsan et al., 2026 ) . On the other hand, using records from a large U.S. university, a study comparing AI-exposed to non-exposed courses found no significant effect of ChatGPT’s arrival on grades, and no difference in self-reported understanding ( Dumlao et al., 2026 ) . Caution in interpreting these prior results is warranted, as publication bias and methodological heterogeneity across studies makes any overarching verdict on AI and learning premature ( Bartoš et al., 2026 ) . The evidence also comes chiefly from learning settings rather than knowledge work, and seldom measures cognitive engagement and output quality within a single design, a gap we address.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究已开始测量外包效应的影响。 在近期针对学生的大型实地研究中，当有AI辅助可用时（例如在家庭作业或非监考测试中），其表现往往有所提升；但当辅助被撤回时（例如在闭卷考试中），表现则会受损（Bastani et al., 2025；Strömberg et al., 2026；Rismanchian et al., 2026）。 类似的效应也出现在对作者身份的记忆（Zindulka et al., 2026）、元认知准确性（Fernandes et al., 2026；Marcoccia et al., 2026），以及专业技能（如临床诊断识别能力）方面（Budzyń et al., 2025）。 这种侵蚀可能是无症状的：在某个高风险的工作场所中，早期的运营收益掩盖了专家判断力的钝化，直到后来才以技能萎缩的形式显现出来（Ehsan et al., 2026）。 另一方面，一项利用美国某大型大学的记录、将接触过AI的课程与未接触过AI的课程进行比较的研究发现，ChatGPT的出现对成绩没有显著影响，在自我报告的理解程度方面也没有差异（Dumlao et al., 2026）。 在解读这些先前结果时应当保持谨慎，因为发表偏倚以及各项研究之间的方法学异质性，使得对AI与学习做出任何总体性结论都为时尚早（Bartoš et al., 2026）。 此外，这些证据主要来自学习场景而非知识工作，而且很少在同一项设计中同时测量认知投入与输出质量，这正是我们着手弥补的空白。

paragraphs.en: In knowledge work, cognitive engagement is a complex constellation of elements at both the individual level (e.g. critical thinking ( Zhi et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) ) and collaborative level (e.g. articulation work ( Riedl et al., 2026 ; Strauss, 1988 ; Schmidt and Bannon, 1992 ) ). At the individual level, memory (often measured as topic recall or source attribution) is a key aspect, and also a key fragility. Prior research has found that AI assistance may be detrimental to memory ( Bastani et al., 2025 ; Zindulka et al., 2026 ; Zhi et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Kreijkes et al., 2025 ) . For example, Zindulka et al. (2026) ’s participants generated and elaborated ideas with and without AI. One week later, correct source attribution had fallen significantly, with the largest decline in mixed human-AI workflows. Other work has found negative impacts of AI assistance on content recall and comprehension ( Zhi et al., 2026 ; Kreijkes et al., 2025 ) . Topic recall can function as a simple indicative measure of individual cognitive engagement.

paragraphs.en: However, cognitive offloading is not monolithic, and nor are its effects on memory and other aspects of cognition. The type of cognitive tasks that people offload and how they direct their effort matters for downstream impact. For example, when given an AI writing tool that provided exposure to high-quality AI-generated examples, participants exerted less effort while practicing, but then wrote better cover letters in later unaided tests, outperforming both web search and personalized feedback from human editors ( Lira et al., 2026 ) . In studies of programmers ( Shen and Tamkin, 2026 ) and students ( Contractor and Reyes, 2026 ) , those who delegated wholesale lost conceptual understanding, yet certain ‘augmentation’ interaction patterns actually preserved learning. Guardrails or engagement techniques that structure learning interactions reversed the harm of unguarded AI assistance ( Bastani et al., 2025 ) and improved learning without withdrawing assistance altogether ( Kazemitabaar et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，认知卸载并不是单一的，它对记忆及认知其他方面的影响也不是单一的。 人们卸载何种类型的认知任务，以及他们如何分配自己的努力，决定了其下游影响。 例如，当使用一款能接触到高质量 AI 生成范例的 AI 写作工具时，参与者在练习过程中付出的努力较少，但在随后无辅助的测试中写出了更好的求职信，表现优于网络搜索和来自人类编辑的个性化反馈（Lira et al., 2026）。 在针对程序员（Shen and Tamkin, 2026）和学生的研究（Contractor and Reyes, 2026）中，那些整体委托的人失去了概念理解，但某些「增强式」交互模式实际上保住了学习效果。 通过护栏或参与技巧来构建学习交互结构，可以扭转无保护 AI 辅助造成的损害（Bastani et al., 2025），并在不必完全撤除辅助的情况下改善学习（Kazemitabaar et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: The timing of cognitive engagement also matters. Requiring students to generate ideas before consulting an LLM conferred no immediate advantage but the largest gains on a later unassisted task ( Wong and Qiu, 2026 ) . In knowledge work tasks with sufficient time available, avoiding unfettered LLM access specifically when initiating work preserved critical thinking and memory retention of materials, while improving overall quality ( Zhi et al., 2026 ) . Overall, scaffolding early-stage thinking during AI-assisted work may be effective in driving cognitive engagement with work material. This early stage entails specifying goals and decomposing tasks for AI, key metacognitive demands that are the counterpart of offloading, and the focus of our study.
paragraphs.zh: 认知投入的时机也很重要。 要求学生在咨询大语言模型之前先自己生成想法，虽然不会带来即时优势，但在后续的无辅助任务中获得了最大的收益（Wong and Qiu, 2026）。 在有充足时间的知识工作任务中，特别是在启动工作时避免不受限制地使用大语言模型，既保留了批判性思维和对材料的记忆，又提高了整体质量（Zhi et al., 2026）。 总体而言，在人工智能辅助工作过程中对早期思考进行支架式支持，可能有效促进对工作材料的认知投入。 这一早期阶段包括为人工智能设定目标并分解任务，这些是元认知的关键要求，是与认知卸载相对应的部分，也是我们研究的重点。

paragraphs.en: The effort AI displaces from producing information reappears as activities necessary for effective delegation. For example, workers experienced in AI are distinguished chiefly by planning in their opening messages ( Sarkar, 2026 ) and more robust verification processes ( Cynthia et al., 2026 ) . These activities recruit metacognitive processes, including self-monitoring, confidence calibration, and cognitive flexibility ( Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ; Fügener et al., 2022 ) . The shift from material production to critical integration therefore imposes metacognitive demands on users as they decide what to delegate to AI ( Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ; Sarkar, 2023 ; Fügener et al., 2022 ; Jussupow et al., 2021 ) , and then grapple with the open-ended loop of prompting–evaluating–interaction, i.e., how to delegate to AI ( Subramonyam et al., 2024 ; Sarkar et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) . Recent work has further demonstrated the role of these metacognitive processes in human–AI interaction ( Singh et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Tankelevitch et al., 2025 ) , including in reasoning ( Fernandes et al., 2026 ; Bo et al., 2025 ) , planning ( Colombatto et al., 2025 ) , information seeking ( Ramesh et al., 2026 ; Mittal et al., 2026 ) , software engineering ( Sarkar, 2026 ) , and data science ( Drosos et al., 2024a ) . These demands may intensify as AI systems take on longer, multi-step workflows. Longer autonomous task horizons leave users with fewer opportunities to intervene, while increasing the consequences of their initial specifications and later verification decisions ( Kwa et al., 2025 ; Passi, 2025 ; Dhanorkar et al., 2026 ) . Addressing the metacognitive demands of AI through interface support therefore remains a priority ( Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能从生产信息中转移出来的努力，会以有效委托所需活动的形式重新出现。 例如，有AI使用经验的工人的主要区别在于他们在开篇消息中就进行规划（Sarkar, 2026），并采用更稳健的验证流程（Cynthia et al., 2026）。 这些活动会调用元认知过程，包括自我监控、信心校准和认知灵活性（Tankelevitch et al., 2024；Fügener et al., 2022）。 因此，从物质生产向批判性整合的转变，对用户提出了元认知要求：他们要决定将什么委托给AI（Tankelevitch et al., 2024；Sarkar, 2023；Fügener et al., 2022；Jussupow et al., 2021），然后还要应对提示—评估—交互这一开放式循环，即如何委托给AI（Subramonyam et al., 2024；Sarkar et al., 2022；Liu et al., 2023）。 最近的研究进一步证明了这些元认知过程在人机交互中的作用（Singh et al., 2025；Lee et al., 2025；Tankelevitch et al., 2025），包括在推理（Fernandes et al., 2026；Bo et al., 2025）、规划（Colombatto et al., 2025）、信息搜寻（Ramesh et al., 2026；Mittal et al., 2026）、软件工程（Sarkar, 2026）和数据科学（Drosos et al., 2024a）中。 随着人工智能系统承担更长、多步骤的工作流程，这些要求可能会加剧。 更长的自主任务周期使用户干预的机会减少，同时增加了他们最初设定和后续验证决策的后果（Kwa et al., 2025；Passi, 2025；Dhanorkar et al., 2026）。 因此，通过界面支持来应对人工智能的元认知要求仍然是一个优先事项（Tankelevitch et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has explored several ways of helping users articulate, explore, clarify, and manage their goals and intents across multi-turn LLM interactions ( Kim et al., 2026b ) . In co-creation workflows, Luminate ( Suh et al., 2024 ) surfaces a multi-dimensional design space from users’ prompts, helping them discover relevant combinations, while Intent Tagging ( Gmeiner et al., 2025b ) represents intentions as granular, reusable units that support flexible, non-linear expression and steering. OnGoal ( Coscia et al., 2025 ) surfaces goals throughout a conversation, using an LLM-assisted pipeline to infer, merge, and evaluate goals against model responses. Dynamic Prompt Middleware ( Drosos et al., 2025 ) augments users’ prompts through dynamically generated interface controls, and IntentFlow ( Kim et al., 2026b ) similarly extracts goals and intents into editable components that let users iteratively articulate, verify, and curate their intents. In line with metacognition research, ( Molenaar et al., 2011 ; Molenaar et al., 2013 ) , a key design pattern across this work is dynamic, activity-contingent support that can be tied to the user’s current problem state and that can therefore be more effective than generic static scaffolds ( Drosos et al., 2024b ; Kim et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究探索了多种方式，帮助用户在多轮大语言模型交互中表达、探索、澄清和管理他们的目标与意图（Kim et al., 2026b）。 在共创工作流中，Luminate（Suh et al., 2024）从用户的提示中呈现一个多维设计空间，帮助他们发现相关的组合；而 Intent Tagging（Gmeiner et al., 2025b）则将意图表示为细粒度、可复用的单元，支持灵活的、非线性的表达与引导。 OnGoal（Coscia et al., 2025）在整个对话过程中呈现目标，利用大语言模型辅助的流水线来推断、合并目标，并根据模型响应对目标进行评估。 Dynamic Prompt Middleware（Drosos et al., 2025）通过动态生成的界面控件增强用户的提示，IntentFlow（Kim et al., 2026b）也类似地将目标和意图提取为可编辑的组件，让用户能够迭代地表达、验证和整理他们的意图。 与元认知研究相一致（Molenaar et al., 2011; Molenaar et al., 2013），这类研究中的一个关键设计模式是动态的、随活动而定的支持，这种支持能够与用户当前的问题状态相关联，因此比通用的静态支架更为有效（Drosos et al., 2024b; Kim et al., 2026b）。

sents.zh: 已有研究探索了多种方式，帮助用户在多轮大语言模型交互中表达、探索、澄清和管理他们的目标与意图（Kim et al., 2026b）。

sents.en: In co-creation workflows, Luminate ( Suh et al., 2024 ) surfaces a multi-dimensional design space from users’ prompts, helping them discover relevant combinations, while Intent Tagging ( Gmeiner et al., 2025b ) represents intentions as granular, reusable units that support flexible, non-linear expression and steering.
sents.zh: 在共创工作流中，Luminate（Suh et al., 2024）从用户的提示中呈现一个多维设计空间，帮助他们发现相关的组合；而 Intent Tagging（Gmeiner et al., 2025b）则将意图表示为细粒度、可复用的单元，支持灵活的、非线性的表达与引导。

sents.en: OnGoal ( Coscia et al., 2025 ) surfaces goals throughout a conversation, using an LLM-assisted pipeline to infer, merge, and evaluate goals against model responses.
sents.zh: OnGoal（Coscia et al., 2025）在整个对话过程中呈现目标，利用大语言模型辅助的流水线来推断、合并目标，并根据模型响应对目标进行评估。

sents.en: Dynamic Prompt Middleware ( Drosos et al., 2025 ) augments users’ prompts through dynamically generated interface controls, and IntentFlow ( Kim et al., 2026b ) similarly extracts goals and intents into editable components that let users iteratively articulate, verify, and curate their intents.
sents.zh: Dynamic Prompt Middleware（Drosos et al., 2025）通过动态生成的界面控件增强用户的提示，IntentFlow（Kim et al., 2026b）也类似地将目标和意图提取为可编辑的组件，让用户能够迭代地表达、验证和整理他们的意图。

sents.en: In line with metacognition research, ( Molenaar et al., 2011 ; Molenaar et al., 2013 ) , a key design pattern across this work is dynamic, activity-contingent support that can be tied to the user’s current problem state and that can therefore be more effective than generic static scaffolds ( Drosos et al., 2024b ; Kim et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: 与元认知研究相一致（Molenaar et al., 2011; Molenaar et al., 2013），这类研究中的一个关键设计模式是动态的、随活动而定的支持，这种支持能够与用户当前的问题状态相关联，因此比通用的静态支架更为有效（Drosos et al., 2024b; Kim et al., 2026b）。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line of work externalizes task structure to help users decompose complex goals, clarify their intentions, and remain aware and in control of their intent at each step. AI Chains ( Wu et al., 2022b ; Wu et al., 2022a ) introduced editable multi-step LLM workflows, an approach echoed in Cocoa’s agentic workflows ( Feng et al., 2026 ) and CoLadder’s links between hierarchical intentions and corresponding code ( Yen et al., 2024 ) . Kazemitabaar et al. (2024a) compared phasewise decomposition (separating assumptions, planning, and code into larger phases) with stepwise decomposition into smaller subgoals, finding that both facilitated steering and verification. Brickify similarly externalizes design intent as manipulable visual tokens, allowing users to specify both the desired elements and how they should be composed; our scaffold applies a related principle to goals and task structure in writing ( Shi et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一条互补的研究路线将任务结构外化，帮助用户分解复杂目标、澄清意图，并在每一步保持对自身意图的觉察与掌控。 AI Chains（Wu et al., 2022b；Wu et al., 2022a）引入了可编辑的多步骤大语言模型工作流，这一思路在 Cocoa 的智能体工作流（Feng et al., 2026）以及 CoLadder 将层级意图与相应代码关联起来的设计中（Yen et al., 2024）得到呼应。Kazemitabaar 等人 （2024a）比较了分阶段分解（将假设、规划和代码分离为较大的阶段）与分步骤分解为更小的子目标两种方式，发现二者都有助于引导和验证。 Brickify 同样将设计意图外化为可操作的视觉标记，允许用户既指定期望的元素，又指定它们应如何组合；我们的支架将类似原则应用于写作中的目标与任务结构（Shi et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Prior work demonstrates how scaffolds can improve users’ goal and intent discovery, clarification, task decomposition, planning, and steering of model behavior. Beyond these UX and interaction outcomes, a few studies suggest that scaffolds can increase output quality in coding ( Yen et al., 2024 ) and other tasks ( Wu et al., 2022b ) , and even improve code comprehension ( Yen et al., 2024 ) . They also reveal a tension around cognitive load, with mixed findings about whether scaffolds’ added options and interaction complexity increase or decrease load compared to common chat interfaces. Together, this work establishes both the promise of metacognitive support for human-AI interaction and its central design challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究工作表明，脚手架可以帮助用户发现目标与意图、进行澄清、任务分解、规划以及引导模型行为。 除了这些用户体验与交互方面的成效外，少数研究表明，脚手架可以提高编程任务（Yen 等，2024）及其他任务（Wu 等，2022b）的输出质量，甚至能改善代码理解能力（Yen 等，2024）。 这些研究还揭示了围绕认知负荷的一种张力：与常见的聊天界面相比，脚手架增加的选项和交互复杂性究竟是增加还是降低了负荷，相关研究发现并不一致。 总体而言，这项工作既确立了元认知支持在人机智能体交互中的前景，也确立了其核心设计挑战。

paragraphs.en: Our work builds on these design approaches and their formative insights, drawing on the positive results of dynamically-generated interface controls ( Drosos et al., 2025 ) to support goal specification and task decomposition. We ask how such scaffolds impact the value of outcomes in knowledge work. As noted above, prior evaluations have largely measured proximal interaction outcomes. Value, however, depends on more distal work outcomes that remain largely untested: objective output quality, whether scaffolds shape users’ interaction patterns in subsequent tasks, and, as one key aspect of cognitive engagement, users’ topic recall of work material. We take a step toward these outcomes, while acknowledging that durable skill change and in-depth cognitive engagement entail complexities well beyond what can be accomplished by an individual worker in a single session. Methodologically, we complement the largely small-scale, within-subjects prior work with a large-scale, between-subjects evaluation designed to isolate scaffolds’ causal effects with greater generalizability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作建立在这些设计方法及其启发性洞见之上，借鉴动态生成界面控件（Drosos et al., 2025）的积极成果，以支持目标设定与任务分解。 我们探究这类支架如何影响知识工作成果的价值。 如上所述，以往评估大多衡量的是近端的交互结果。 然而，价值取决于更多仍基本未经检验的远端工作成果：客观的产出质量、支架是否会塑造用户在后续任务中的交互模式，以及作为认知投入关键方面的用户对工作材料的主题回忆。 我们朝这些成果迈出一步，同时承认持久技能改变与深度认知投入所涉及的复杂性，远非单个工作者在单次会话中所能完成。 在方法上，我们以一项大规模、被试间评估，补充以往大多为小规模、被试内设计的研究，旨在以更强的可推广性分离支架的因果效应。

paragraphs.en: RQ1: Do scaffolds improve AI-assisted writing quality, and do effects carry over when working with AI in the absence of scaffolds?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1：脚手架能否提升 AI 辅助写作的质量？并且在没有脚手架的情况下与 AI 协作时，其效果能否延续？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: As a mechanism for potential carry-over effects, do scaffolds change how people prompt AI systems in the absence of scaffolds?

paragraphs.en: We conducted a randomized between-subjects experiment focusing on AI-assisted writing ( Figure 2 ). In a main study session, participants completed two comparable professional-writing tasks in counterbalanced order. In Task 1, participants assigned to the metacognitive scaffold condition used an interface with dynamically generated controls to support goal specification and task decomposition, whereas control group participants used the otherwise identical chat-and-canvas interface without these panels. This contrast therefore evaluates the effect of concurrent scaffold access. In Task 2, participants in both conditions used the unscaffolded interface. This contrast tests short-lag transfer after scaffold removal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开展了一项聚焦AI辅助写作的被试间随机实验（图2）。 在主要研究环节中，参与者以平衡顺序完成了两项可比的专业写作任务。 在任务1中，被分配到元认知支架条件的参与者使用的界面带有动态生成的控件，以支持目标设定与任务分解，而对照组参与者使用的则是除此之外完全相同的对话与画布界面，但不带这些面板。 因此，这一对比评估的是同时使用支架的效果。 在任务2中，两组条件的参与者都使用无支架的界面。 这一对比检验的是移除支架后的短时延迟迁移。

paragraphs.en: Following ethics authorization 1 1 1 Anonymized for review , we recruited participants from Prolific. Participants provided informed consent electronically before taking part. A total of 342 participants entered the study and were compensated £20/hour. Of these, 44 participants did not submit a final essay or their essay could not be recovered; one participant’s baseline questionnaire was not saved due to technical difficulties. The final analytic sample for the primary analyses of writing quality and prompting therefore comprised 297 participants who completed both writing tasks (control = 144; treatment = 153) and 594 essays. Survey analyses used all participants with complete data on the relevant baseline and post-task items (279–295 per item; Table A12 ). Cognitive-load analyses used 277 participants with measurements at both analyzed timepoints. Despite a reward being announced at the end of the session (a chance to win one of 20 extra Prolific rewards of over £30 for completing the follow-up), attrition for the follow-up survey was high: 159 participants returned (we address this in Section 3.5.3 ). All participants were based in the United States and reported English as their first language ( Table 1 summarizes participant characteristics).
paragraphs.zh: 在获得伦理批准（已匿名化以供评审）后，我们从 Prolific 招募了参与者。 参与者在参与前以电子方式提供了知情同意。 共有 342 名参与者进入研究，报酬为每小时 20 英镑。 其中，44 名参与者未提交最终文章或其文章无法恢复；另有一名参与者的基线问卷因技术故障未能保存。 因此，用于写作质量与提示行为主要分析的最终分析样本包括完成了两项写作任务的 297 名参与者（对照组 = 144；实验组 = 153）以及 594 篇文章。 问卷调查分析使用了在相关基线和任务后题目上数据完整的所有参与者（每题 279–295 人；见表 A12）。 认知负荷分析使用了在两个分析时间点均有测量数据的 277 名参与者。 尽管在会话结束时宣布了奖励（有机会赢得 20 份额外 Prolific 奖励之一，超过 30 英镑，用于完成后续调查），后续调查的流失率仍然很高：仅有 159 名参与者返回（我们在第 3.5.3 节中对此进行讨论）。 所有参与者均位于美国，并报告英语为第一语言（表 1 总结了参与者特征）。

paragraphs.en: In both conditions, participants completed each task in a browser-based writing environment consisting of a chat panel connected to GPT-5.3 with medium reasoning effort and an editable canvas panel. paragraphs.en: The scaffold was motivated by work on dynamic prompt middleware, showing that context-sensitive interface controls can increase steering precision, perceived control and task reflection when interacting with AI ( Drosos et al., 2025 ) . Broadly, its metacognitive support focused on intent articulation and exploration as defined by Kim et al. (2026b) . Concretely, it was implemented as a two-phase dynamic interface ( Section A.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该框架的设计灵感来自动态提示词中间件的相关研究，该研究表明，在与 AI 交互时，情境敏感的界面控制可以提升引导精度、感知控制力和任务反思（Drosos 等，2025）。 从广义上讲，其元认知支持聚焦于 Kim 等（2026b）所定义的意图表达与探索。 具体而言，它被实现为一个两阶段的动态界面（第 A.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: After the participant entered a high-level request, the system rendered a goal specification panel that externalized the rhetorical problem through editable fields for the message to convey, target reader, desired reader outcome, primary writing objective and desired scope/depth (see figure 1 , panels A.1 and A.2). This phase targeted explicit problem representation, reducing ambiguity about what would count as a good response. Once those inputs were specified, the interface rendered a task decomposition panel that generated task-specific controls for analytical approaches, writing structure and critical considerations to address in the brief. This phase targeted actionability and verification (see figure 1 , panels A.3 and A.4). Participants could also request modifications to these controls in natural language through a dedicated workspace control panel (see figure 1 , panel A.5). This mapping from clarified goals to decomposed sub-goals follows classic theories of hierarchical problem solving ( Newell and Simon, 1972 ; Shepherd, 2001 ) and recent human–AI interface work on decomposable steering ( Kazemitabaar et al., 2024a ; Kim et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2022b ) . Importantly, the scaffold was not a fixed prompt template: the options shown were generated and updated from the participant’s current request, prior selections and current phase of work. The selected controls then informed the writing interaction for Task 1 only.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者输入高层次请求后，系统渲染出一个目标规格面板，通过可编辑字段将修辞问题外显化，这些字段包括要传达的信息、目标读者、期望的读者效果、主要写作目标以及期望的范围/深度（见图 1，面板 A.1 和 A.2）。 这一阶段针对显式的问题表征，减少了对何为良好回应的模糊性。 一旦这些输入被确定，界面便渲染出一个任务分解面板，为分析方法、写作结构以及简报中需要处理的关键考量生成任务特定的控件。 这一阶段针对可操作性与可验证性（见图 1，面板 A.3 和 A.4）。 参与者还可以通过专门的工作区控件面板，以自然语言请求对这些控件进行修改（见图 1，面板 A.5）。 这种从已澄清目标到已分解子目标的映射，遵循了经典的分层问题解决理论（Newell and Simon, 1972；Shepherd, 2001）以及近期关于可分解引导的人机界面研究（Kazemitabaar et al., 2024a；Kim et al., 2026b；Wu et al., 2022b）。 重要的是，该支架并非固定的提示模板：所显示的选项是根据参与者当前的请求、先前的选择以及当前工作阶段生成并更新的。 所选控件仅对任务 1 的写作交互产生影响。

paragraphs.en: The control condition presented the same conversational AI and editable canvas without the goal specification and task decomposition panels. We selected this naturalistic control because our primary interest was the total effect of adding the complete dynamic scaffold to a familiar AI-assisted writing workflow: a standard chat-and-canvas interface is the workflow into which such a scaffold would ordinarily be introduced and therefore a pragmatically meaningful baseline. It also preserves user agency: control participants could clarify goals, plan and decompose the task through ordinary prompting if they chose to, but the interface did not require or prime those activities.

paragraphs.en: Both prototypes were browser-based web applications (React and Node.js). paragraphs.en: We defined open-ended but bounded knowledge-work tasks that required persuasion, synthesis, audience sensitivity, and explicit coordination with AI. Each task consisted of producing a realistic knowledge-work brief: (1) a city-planning proposal on whether to adopt a 4-day work week for municipal employees; and (2) a consulting brief on how to launch a hybrid-work model for a major client (see Appendix A.2 ). Participants saw the full scenario description at the start of each task and could open a brief task reminder while working. Sessions were self-paced with a maximum completion time of 80 minutes and time on task was recorded for each writing task. To increase motivation and effort, all participants were offered a £20 bonus (or equivalent) for each brief ranked in the top five.
paragraphs.zh: 我们定义了开放式但有边界限定的知识型工作任务，这些任务需要说服力、综合归纳能力、对受众的敏感性，以及与 AI 的显性协调。 每个任务都要求撰写一份真实的知识型工作简报：(1) 一份关于市政府雇员是否实行每周 4 天工作制的城市规划提案；(2) 一份关于如何为重要客户推出混合办公模式的咨询简报（见附录 A.2）。 参与者在每个任务开始时可以看到完整的情景描述，并在工作过程中可以打开一个简短的任务提醒。 任务由参与者自行控制进度，最长完成时间为 80 分钟，并且每个写作任务的用时都被记录下来。 为了提高参与者的动机和投入程度，所有参与者每有一份简报排名进入前五名，就可获得 20 英镑（或等值金额）的奖励。

paragraphs.en: The primary outcome was essay quality, scored using GPT-5.4 with high reasoning effort against a seven-item analytic rubric, each item rated 1–4: context and purpose , recommendation clarity , argument quality , evidence credibility , feasibility , impact and organization (items A–G; Appendix B ), and averaged across the seven items. The judge was calibrated against a human rating benchmark as described below ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Pan et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Gu and others, 2024 ; Liew and Tan, 2025 ; Seßler et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 主要结局指标为文章质量，使用 GPT-5.4 以高推理努力程度依据一份包含七个条目的分析性评分量表进行评分，每个条目评分为 1–4：情境与目的、建议清晰度、论证质量、证据可信度、可行性、影响与组织结构（条目 A–G；附录 B ），并对七个条目取平均值。 如下文所述，该评判模型已依据人类评分基准进行了校准（ Zheng et al., 2023 ; Pan et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Gu and others, 2024 ; Liew and Tan, 2025 ; Seßler et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ）。

paragraphs.en: An initial scoring pass on formatted essay text showed sensitivity to layout cues: scaffold-condition essays contained more visible headings and denser section marking, and these features explained additional variance in judge scores beyond the human benchmark. Scoring was therefore conducted on de-formatted essays, stripped of all markup and visual formatting (headings, emphasis, list markers, indentation, rules and repeated whitespace); heading text was retained as ordinary lines, paragraph breaks were normalized, and all lexical content and sentence order were preserved.
paragraphs.zh: 对格式化作文文本的初步评分显示，评分对版式线索敏感：脚手架条件下的作文包含更多可见标题和更密集的章节标记，而这些特征在人类基准之外解释了评判分数的额外方差。 因此，评分在去除格式的作文上进行，剥离所有标记和视觉格式（标题、强调、列表符号、缩进、分隔线和重复空白）；标题文本作为普通行保留，段落换行被规范化，并保留所有词汇内容和句子顺序。

paragraphs.en: A separate sample of Prolific raters (£25 per hour) rated 117 essays (20% of the 594-essay corpus; selected at random, stratified by task and condition), two raters per essay, as participants had formatted them, on the seven rubric dimensions shared with the LLM judge (items A–G) in a custom interface ( Section B.2 ); the two ratings were averaged within essay to form the human benchmark.

paragraphs.en: Each de-formatted essay was scored in five consecutive runs, averaged into the final judge score. paragraphs.en: To characterize participants’ process after scaffold removal, we analyzed the participant-authored prompt sequences from the participant–AI chat logs in Task 2. Each sequence was coded on two dimensions using the codebook in Appendix C : goal clarity (GC), which captures how explicitly participants stated the intended outcome, audience, constraints and success criteria (seven indicators), and task decomposition (TD), which captures whether they divided the work into concrete steps or components (six indicators). Because goal specification and task decomposition can unfold over several conversational turns, the unit of analysis was the entire participant-authored prompt sequence rather than any single message. All sequences were supplied to coders in a standardized plain-text form with condition labels and assignment metadata removed.
paragraphs.zh: 为了刻画参与者在脚手架移除后的过程，我们分析了任务2中参与者—AI聊天记录里由参与者撰写的提示词序列。 每个序列使用附录C中的编码本在两个维度上进行编码：目标清晰度（GC），捕捉参与者多大程度上明确陈述了预期结果、受众、限制条件和成功标准（七个指标）；以及任务分解（TD），捕捉他们是否将工作划分为具体的步骤或组成部分（六个指标）。 由于目标设定和任务分解可能在多个对话轮次中展开，分析单位是参与者撰写的完整提示词序列，而非任何单条消息。 所有序列均以标准化纯文本形式提供给编码员，并移除了条件标签和分配元数据。

paragraphs.en: To establish that the codebook could be applied consistently, three of the researchers independently coded 60 of the sequences (20%), blind to condition, assigning the codebook’s ordinal GC and TD ratings (0–3) and marking each of the 13 indicators as present or absent. An LLM coder (GPT-5.4, temperature 0, no extended reasoning) then applied the same codebook to the same 60 sequences, making one request per indicator and one per overall rating, without access to the human codes. Agreement among the human coders, and between the LLM coder and the human coders, is reported in Table A2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了确定该编码本能够被一致地应用，三名研究者在对实验条件不知情的情况下，独立对其中60个序列（占20%）进行了编码，按照编码本给出GC和TD的顺序评分（0–3），并逐一标注13项指标为“存在”或“不存在”。 随后，一个LLM编码器（GPT-5.4，温度设为0，不启用扩展推理）使用同一编码本对同样的60个序列进行编码，每项指标发起一次请求，每项总体评分发起一次请求，且无法接触人类编码结果。 人类编码者之间的一致性，以及LLM编码器与人类编码者之间的一致性，见表A2。

paragraphs.en: For the transfer analysis itself, the LLM coder scored every Task 2 sequence with a graded version of the same 13 indicators: rather than marking each as present or absent, it rated each from 0 (absent) to 3 (well specified), quoting the passages of the participant’s text on which the rating rested, in five independent runs. The GC (0–21), TD (0–18) and Combined (0–39) scores are the sums of these indicator ratings, averaged across the five runs. The coder saw the task brief and reminder but no information about condition. Some participants pasted the task wording verbatim as their prompt, so their process could not be meaningfully coded: if any prompt reproduced at least half of the task reminder (13 consecutive words of its 26) or at least half of the scenario description, every indicator in that sequence was set to zero, and the sequence was retained in the analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 在迁移分析本身中，LLM 编码员使用同一组13项指标的分级版本对每个任务2序列进行评分：不是将每项指标标记为出现或未出现，而是对每项从0（未出现）到3（表述完善）进行评级，并引用参与者文本中支撑该评级的段落，共独立进行五次。 GC（0–21）、TD（0–18）和综合（0–39）分数是这些指标评级之和，并取五次运行的平均值。 编码员可以看到任务说明和提醒，但看不到任何关于条件的信息。 一些参与者将任务原文逐字粘贴作为其提示词，因此其过程无法进行有意义的编码：如果任何提示词复现了任务提醒的至少一半（26个词中的13个连续词）或情境描述的至少一半，该序列中的所有指标均被置为零，且该序列仍保留在分析中。

paragraphs.en: Participants completed 13 pre- and post-task items concerning goal specification, planning, task decomposition, and writing metacognition. Eight items were adapted from the Metacognitive Awareness Inventory ( Schraw and Dennison, 1994 ) , and five drew on the Metacognitive Strategies in Writing questionnaire ( Qin et al., 2022 ) (of which four were adapted from the Metacognitive Strategies of Writing Survey ( Al Moqbali et al., 2020 ) ). The wording and sources of all items are reported in Table A12 .

paragraphs.en: Participants rated perceived AI helpfulness and control on 1–5 scales. Cognitive load was measured after each task using five NASA-TLX dimensions: mental demand, temporal demand, perceived performance, effort and frustration ( Hart and Staveland, 1988 ) ; physical demand was not administered. Items were rated from 1 to 10; the positively worded performance item was reverse-coded as 11 − x 11-x so that higher values indicated greater load, and the five items were averaged with equal weight when all five were observed into an unweighted raw NASA-TLX score. Nine additional study-specific questions about the demands of AI-assisted writing were analyzed at item level ( Table 4 ) and not included in the overall score; their equal-weight mean, requiring all nine responses, was used as a recall auxiliary.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者按 1–5 分量表对感知到的 AI 有用性和控制感进行评分。 认知负荷在每个任务结束后使用 NASA-TLX 的五个维度进行测量：心理需求、时间需求、感知绩效、努力和挫败感（Hart 和 Staveland，1988）；未采用体力需求维度。 各题项按 1 到 10 分评分；措辞为正向的绩效题项按 11 − x 11-x 进行反向编码，使数值越高表示负荷越大；当五个题项均有观测值时，将它们以相等权重平均，得到未加权的原始 NASA-TLX 分数。 另有九个关于 AI 辅助写作需求的针对本研究的特定问题在题项层面进行分析（表 4），不计入总分；其等权均值（要求九题全部作答）被用作回忆辅助指标。

paragraphs.en: Three days after the writing session, participants were invited to complete a voluntary follow-up survey about the topics of both essays. Among the returners, 20 randomly picked participants received an extra £30 reward through Prolific as incentive. Despite the potential reward being announced at the end of task 2, attrition was high: 159 participants returned to complete the follow-up survey (we address this in Section 3.5.3 ). The analyzed topic-recall outcome was free recall of the writing topic for each of the tasks, in answer to: “What topic did you write about in your [first/second] essay? If you don’t remember, you can write “Don’t remember”.” (see Table A6 for full survey wording). The open-text responses for each task were coded manually into binary correct/incorrect, scored leniently: a response was credited for each task if it identified the assigned topic or the other task’s topic, allowing for confusion about task order.
paragraphs.zh: 写作环节结束三天后，参与者被邀请完成一项关于两篇文章主题的自愿后续调查。 在返回的参与者中，通过 Prolific 随机抽取 20 名参与者额外获得 30 英镑奖励作为激励。 尽管在任务 2 结束时已宣布可能的奖励，流失率仍然很高：159 名参与者返回完成了后续调查（我们在第 3.5.3 节中讨论这一点）。 所分析的主题回忆结果是自由回忆每项任务的写作主题，回答以下问题：“你在你的[第一/第二]篇文章中写了什么主题？ 如果你不记得了，可以写“不记得”。”（完整调查措辞见表 A6）。 每项任务的开放式回答由人工编码为正确的/不正确的二元类别，评分标准宽松：只要回答识别出所分配的主题或另一任务的主题即计为正确，允许对任务顺序产生混淆。

paragraphs.en: Unless otherwise stated, analysis models were adjusted for six baseline indicators: whether participants reported using AI for writing, baseline AI-use frequency, self-rated essay-writing skill, task decomposition, AI prompting (preparing appropriate information for the AI), and AI evaluating (reviewing one’s judgment before accepting or rejecting an AI recommendation), the latter two taken from the AI metacognition scale of Sidra and Mason (2025) . This subset covers writing-specific experience, perceived task competence and relevant metacognitive processes while limiting overlapping item content. Models also included outcome-specific design terms described below.
paragraphs.zh: 除非另有说明，分析模型均对六个基线指标进行了调整：参与者是否报告使用AI进行写作、基线AI使用频率、自评的论文写作技能、任务分解、AI提示（为AI准备合适的信息）以及AI评估（在接受或拒绝AI建议前审查自己的判断），后两项取自Sidra和Mason（2025）的AI元认知量表。 这一子集涵盖了写作相关的经验、感知到的任务胜任力以及相关的元认知过程，同时限制了条目内容的重叠。 模型还包含了下文所述的针对特定结果的设计变量。

paragraphs.en: Essay quality for the two tasks was analyzed with linear mixed-effects models including a participant random intercept (for the repeated measures across tasks), fixed effects for task order, treatment condition and their interaction, topic fixed effects for scenario differences, and the common covariate set ( Section 3.4.6 ). paragraphs.en: Rubric item-level contrasts were estimated for each of the seven dimensions separately, in two samples. For the judge across the full 594-essay corpus, each dimension was analyzed with the same mixed-model specification as the composite. For the 107-essay human benchmark, analyzed for both the judge (de-formatted text) and the human raters (formatted text), the composite and dimension-level models used the same fixed effects without a random intercept, estimated by ordinary least squares with standard errors clustered by participant. The benchmark analyses estimate separate between-subjects condition contrasts within Task 1 and Task 2; we do not test their difference. The rubric-level analyses are exploratory and are reported with uncorrected P P values; the composite contrasts are the primary tests. Standardized effect sizes for the essay-quality contrasts were computed at the participant level within each task as Hedges’ g g , using the pooled raw standard deviation of the de-formatted essay score; we additionally report the covariate-adjusted between-condition difference divided by the same pooled raw standard deviation.

The unweighted five-dimension NASA-TLX score for both tasks was analyzed with a linear mixed model including condition, timepoint and their interaction, with a participant random intercept; simple condition contrasts were derived for Task 1 and Task 2. paragraphs.en: A total of 159 participants provided recall outcomes for both tasks. Binary recall outcomes were analyzed using logistic mixed-effects models with a participant random intercept. Fixed effects included scaffold condition, task position (first or second), their interaction, writing scenario, and the six common covariates ( Section 3.4.6 ). Planned condition contrasts for each task were calculated from the fixed-effect coefficients and their covariance matrix and exponentiated to obtain conditional odds ratios (ORs) for the treatment effect (scaffold versus control in Task 1; previously scaffolded versus control in Task 2).

paragraphs.en: Treatment assignment did not predict missingness (OR = 1.03 =1.03 , 95% CI [0.66, 1.59], P = .911 P=.911 ; logistic regression on the recall cohort, with one indicator per participant, since both recall outcomes were always jointly observed or jointly missing). To test whether other observed characteristics predicted missingness, we fitted a Firth-penalized logistic regression ( Heinze and Ploner, 2002 ) on 26 predictors, including treatment, baseline and outcome survey scores, essay quality scores and other predictors, using the 234 participants with complete predictor data; coefficients are reported uncorrected in Table A11 . Jointly, observed characteristics did not predict missingness (penalized likelihood-ratio χ 2 ​ ( 26 ) = 26.40 \chi^{2}(26)=26.40 , P = .441 P=.441 ). Two of 26 coefficients had uncorrected P < .05 P<.05 , against 1.3 expected under a global null: higher Task 1 essay quality was associated with lower odds of missingness (OR per SD = 0.67 =0.67 , 95% CI [0.47, 0.94], P = .021 P=.021 ) and higher combined Task 2 prompt quality with higher odds (OR per SD = 1.36 =1.36 , 95% CI [1.02, 1.80], P = .033 P=.033 ). The imputation model included essay quality as an auxiliary variable but excluded coded prompt quality.

paragraphs.en: To assess sensitivity to missing follow-up data, we additionally imputed the missing recall data using multiple imputation by chained equations (MICE) ( Wijesuriya et al., 2025 ; White et al., 2011 ) . The imputation model represented the two recall outcomes in separate columns and included condition, first-task scenario, their interaction and the six common baseline covariates. Auxiliaries comprised ten complete-item survey means covering general and writing metacognition, AI metacognition, prompting, workload and AI-writing demand at their administered timepoints; both essay-quality scores; log durations; log-transformed prompt and essay-word counts ( log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) ); helpfulness and perceived control; and submission, cohort-membership, repeated/missing-form, follow-up-intent and incentive-awareness indicators. Specifically, binary variables were imputed by logistic regression and other numeric variables by predictive mean matching with five donors, observed values were preserved, and 50 completed datasets were generated for the recall cohort (100 iterations per chain). The recall model was fitted in each dataset and task-specific log-odds contrasts were pooled with Rubin’s rules and t t inference.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估对缺失随访数据的敏感性，我们另外使用链式方程多重插补（MICE）对缺失的回忆数据进行插补（Wijesuriya et al., 2025; White et al., 2011）。 插补模型将两个回忆结果分别放在不同的列中表示，并包含条件、首任务情境、二者的交互项以及六个共同的基线协变量。 辅助变量包括十个完整条目的调查均值，涵盖其施测时点的一般与写作元认知、AI元认知、提示（prompting）、工作负荷和AI写作需求；两个作文质量得分；日志时长；对数变换后的提示与作文字数（log(1+x)）；有用性与感知控制；以及提交、队列归属、重复/缺失表单、随访意向和知晓激励的指示变量。 具体而言，二元变量通过逻辑回归进行插补，其他数值变量通过带五个供体的预测均值匹配进行插补，观测值保持不变，并为回忆队列生成了50个完整数据集（每条链100次迭代）。 在每个数据集中拟合回忆模型，并使用Rubin法则和t推断对任务特定的对数几率对比进行合并。

paragraphs.en: Prompt-coding analyses were conducted at the prompt-sequence level. paragraphs.en: Our primary question was whether the scaffold improved writing quality while it was available and whether any advantage carried into the subsequent unscaffolded task. Essay quality was assessed along seven rubric dimensions (A–G), each on a 1–4 scale, using the de-formatted essay text and calibrated LLM judge described in Methods. We report the overall score before examining the dimensions separately.

paragraphs.en: For the primary measure, we computed an overall quality score averaged across the seven rubric dimensions (see Section 4.1.2 for per-rubric analyses). Scaffolded writers scored higher than controls (mixed-model treatment coefficient b = 0.089 b=0.089 , 95% confidence interval (CI) [0.023, 0.155], P = .008 P=.008 ; composite row of Table 2 ; full model in Table A7 ). The treatment-by-order interaction was negative but not statistically reliable ( b = − 0.019 b=-0.019 , 95% CI [ − 0.102 -0.102 , 0.065 0.065 ], P = .665 P=.665 ), providing no clear evidence that the condition difference varied between tasks. The Task 2 contrast remained positive ( b = 0.070 b=0.070 , 95% CI [0.004, 0.136], P = .037 P=.037 ), where both groups wrote without the scaffold ( Figure 3 shows the raw score distributions). The corresponding raw standardized differences on the 1–4 essay scale were Hedges’ g = 0.29 g=0.29 in Task 1 and g = 0.21 g=0.21 in Task 2; covariate-adjusted differences divided by the same pooled raw standard deviations were 0.28 and 0.23, respectively ( Table A9 ).

paragraphs.en: The overall score raises a further question: which aspects of writing benefited from the scaffold? We therefore analyzed each of the seven dimensions separately ( Table 2 ), first for the LLM judge across the full set of 594 essays, using the same mixed model as the composite, and then for both the judge and the human raters within the 107-essay benchmark. The full-corpus analysis provides the broadest picture of the scaffold’s contribution, while the benchmark offers a complementary comparison of the two rating approaches on the same essays. These rubric-level analyses are exploratory and use uncorrected P P values to characterize the pattern across dimensions. With 52 Task 1 and 55 Task 2 essays, the benchmark yields less precise estimates, but helps assess whether the direction of the composite advantage is shared across rating approaches and which qualities each approach emphasizes. Its contrasts describe the advantage within each task; persistence within individuals is assessed using the full corpus.

paragraphs.en: Across all 594 essays, the judge’s results suggest that the scaffold supported several substantive aspects of writing. In Task 1, advantages were reliable for Argument quality ( P = .004 P=.004 ), Evidence credibility ( P = .011 P=.011 ) and Impact ( P = .019 P=.019 ), suggesting stronger arguments, more credible supporting evidence and better consideration of consequences. Estimates for Context and purpose and Feasibility were also positive, although they did not reach statistical significance ( P = .071 P=.071 and P = .074 P=.074 ). In Task 2, after the scaffold was removed, advantages remained evident in Context and purpose ( P = .002 P=.002 ) and Impact ( P = .039 P=.039 ), alongside a positive estimate for Argument quality ( P = .062 P=.062 ). Recommendation clarity and Organization did not differ reliably between conditions in either task. Taken together, this exploratory pattern suggests that the scaffold’s contribution extended across several substantive dimensions during use, with evidence of subsequent benefits in how writers framed their briefs and considered their consequences.

paragraphs.en: The 107-essay benchmark provides a complementary perspective on the scaffold’s benefits. Human raters of the formatted essays identified the largest advantage in Feasibility , reliable in both tasks ( P < .001 P<.001 ), together with Organization ( P = .007 P=.007 ) and Recommendation clarity ( P = .021 P=.021 ) in Task 1 and Context and purpose ( P = .028 P=.028 ), Evidence credibility ( P = .036 P=.036 ) and Argument quality ( P = .043 P=.043 ) in Task 2. All seven of their Task 2 estimates were positive, and removing any single dimension left their composite advantage reliable in both tasks, indicating that the human-rated result was not dependent on one dimension alone. The de-formatted judge’s benchmark composite estimates also pointed in a positive direction in both tasks (0.068 and 0.066), although they were smaller than the human-rated estimates (0.440 and 0.433). Its dimension-level contrasts were not individually significant in this smaller sample; nevertheless, its largest Task 1 estimates were for Argument quality , Evidence credibility and Impact , the same three dimensions that showed reliable advantages in the full corpus. The two rating approaches therefore agree in the direction of the composite estimates while highlighting different aspects of writing: human ratings particularly emphasize feasibility, and the full-corpus judge results emphasize argument quality, evidence credibility and impact. These exploratory findings suggest that the scaffold’s contribution can be visible through complementary perspectives on writing quality.

paragraphs.en: The Organization results bear on concerns that LLM judges favor surface presentation or formatting cues ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) : the de-formatted judge showed no Organization advantage in either task, in the full set or the subset, whereas human raters of the formatted essays did in Task 1, so whatever structural cues survived de-formatting did not drive the judge-rated effect.
paragraphs.zh: 本组织（Organization）维度的结果涉及一个担忧，即 LLM 评审者可能偏爱表面表达或格式线索（Zheng et al., 2023）：去除格式后的评审者无论在完整集合还是子集中，都未表现出组织维度上的优势，而人类评分者对保留格式的作文在任务 1 中确实表现出了这种优势，因此在去除格式后留存下来的结构线索并未驱动评审者所评出的效应。

paragraphs.en: The Task 2 quality advantage could reflect transfer of a more deliberate way of specifying work to the AI. paragraphs.en: Memory is a key requirement of cognitive engagement with work. We asked participants to complete a voluntary follow-up survey approximately three days after their session to test recall of their writing topics. paragraphs.en: As generative AI shifts knowledge work from production toward planning and evaluation, this study found that dynamic metacognitive scaffolds improved written output quality, both while the scaffold was available and after it was removed. Participants who had used the scaffold also later wrote prompts with greater goal clarity and task decomposition on their own. We also found evidence for improvement in topic recall three days later. However, even as their written output and prompting improved, scaffolded participants rated the system as less helpful, felt less in control, and reported greater cognitive load while the scaffold was active. Our discussion focuses on the implications of these finding for different levels of knowledge work, the divergence between subjective and objective measures, designing productive friction with visible value into AI assistance, and implications as agentic autonomy increases. Finally, our results have important limitations and present opportunities for future research.

paragraphs.en: Our results suggest that metacognitive scaffolding may matter at three different levels of knowledge work: how people approach a task, how they work with the AI on it, and how well they understand the work itself.

paragraphs.en: The first level includes engaging in metacognitive processes and becoming aware of them. The scaffold improved output quality across tasks, and scaffolded participants engaged in more goal specification and task decomposition in their prompts. This latter aspect is where the scaffold had its most reliable effect, with participants both reporting more task structuring and actively doing so after scaffold removal. They did not, however, report setting clearer goals. Clarifying goals may need more than one supported episode, or a different kind of support, before people both do it and notice that they have improved ( Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ; Schraw and Moshman, 1995 ; Zimmerman, 2000 ) ; we return to this divergence in Section 5.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 第一层包括参与元认知过程并对其产生觉察。 该支架在各任务中均提升了输出质量，且使用支架的参与者在提示中进行了更多的目标设定与任务分解。 后一方面是支架产生最可靠效果之处：参与者既报告了更多的任务结构化行为，也在支架移除后主动继续这样做。 然而，他们并未报告设定了更清晰的目标。 目标澄清可能需要不止一次受支持的练习，或需要不同类型的支持，人们才能既付诸行动又察觉到自己有所改进（Tankelevitch 等，2024；Schraw 和 Moshman，1995；Zimmerman，2000）；我们将在 5.3 节回到这一差异。

paragraphs.en: The second level is how people learn to direct AI systems. We have some evidence of short-lag transfer ( Barnett and Ceci, 2002 ) : participants who had used the scaffold went on to write better essays and clearer, better-structured prompts on their own. Scaffold removal was part of our experimental design, but we are not suggesting that metacognitive support must eventually be removed. Such support, however, cannot be guaranteed in diverse knowledge work contexts. How well someone directs an AI system is much of what separates people who get value from these tools from those who do not, and that skill is unevenly distributed ( Sarkar, 2026 ; Kazemitabaar et al., 2024a ) . A brief scaffold that leads people to prompt more deliberately is a cheap way to build a scarce skill, and one that may follow the user from one tool to the next, whether scaffolds are available or not.

Prior research has found AI assistance to be detrimental ( Bastani et al., 2025 ; Zindulka et al., 2026 ; Zhi et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Kreijkes et al., 2025 ) : one week after generating and elaborating ideas with and without AI, Zindulka et al. (2026) ’s participants misattributed sources significantly more, most of all in mixed human–AI workflows. Our scaffolded participants also engaged in mixed-human-AI workflows, yet were more likely to recall the topics of their writing three days later. Our comparison is between two AI-assisted conditions, so it does not contradict evidence that AI impairs retention relative to unaided work. Rather, it suggests that metacognitive scaffolds may mitigate this impact relative to default chat interfaces. Memory, and cognitive engagement more broadly, is also richer than topic recall, and future work should explore this. Finally, we interpret our findings cautiously: the contrasts were significant across analyses but estimated imprecisely, and rest on the half of the cohort who returned (see Limitations in Section 5.5 ).

paragraphs.en: A tension in our results is that scaffolded participants performed better yet rated the AI as less helpful. This is not unexpected ( Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ) , as the scaffolds required participants to analyze the task and make decisions, demanding cognitive effort and time. This echoes the concept of ‘desirable difficulties’ in learning sciences, where certain effortful engagement can feel aversive, yet lead to better learning outcomes ( Bjork et al., 2011 ) . For example, active learning that cognitively engages students improves objective learning yet is rated lower by students who subjectively experience poorer learning ( Deslauriers et al., 2019 ) . Conversely, fluent instructors can increase interest and perceptions of learning without affecting objective performance ( Carpenter et al., 2020 ) . However, not all difficulties are desirable: designing for productive friction is key as we discuss in Section 5.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果中存在一个矛盾之处：接受脚手架支持的参与者的表现更好，但他们对AI的有用性评价却更低。 这一结果并不意外（Tankelevitch et al., 2024），因为脚手架要求参与者分析任务并做出决策，这需要付出认知努力和时间。 这与学习科学中的「合意困难」概念相呼应，即某些需要付出努力的投入过程可能令人不适，却能带来更好的学习结果（Bjork et al., 2011）。 例如，在认知上调动学生的主动学习能够提升客观学习效果，但主观上感到学习效果较差的学生对此类教学方式的评价却更低（Deslauriers et al., 2019）。 相反，表达流畅的讲师可以在不影响客观表现的情况下提升学生的兴趣和学习感知（Carpenter et al., 2020）。 然而，并非所有困难都是合意的：正如我们在5.3节中讨论的那样，为生产性摩擦进行设计是关键。

paragraphs.en: A similar dissociation appeared in the subjective and objective measures of metacognition: participants reported breaking the task into smaller steps but not setting clearer goals, whereas their prompts in the unscaffolded task showed gains in both . One reading is that the two processes differ in how visible they are to those performing them. Decomposition leaves inspectable traces, such as a list of parts, whereas a clearer goal may simply feel like knowing what one wants, without any awareness that one now specifies it more explicitly ( Nelson and Narens, 1990 ; Efklides, 2008 ; Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ) ; self-report registers the process that generates such cues.
paragraphs.zh: 元认知的主观测量与客观测量中出现了类似的分离：参与者报告会将任务拆分为更小的步骤，但并未设定更清晰的目标，而他们在无脚手架任务中的提示词在这两方面都有提升。 一种解读是，这两个过程对执行者而言的可见程度不同。 分解会留下可检视的痕迹，例如各部分的清单，而更清晰的目标可能只是让人感觉自己知道想要什么，却意识不到自己现在将其表述得更加明确了（Nelson and Narens, 1990；Efklides, 2008；Tankelevitch et al., 2024）；自我报告所记录的正是产生这类线索的过程。

paragraphs.en: More broadly, subjective and objective measures of AI-assisted work can diverge, which in itself reflects a limitation of metacognition. The pattern recurs across the literature: self-rated critical thinking varied little across conditions whose measured performance differed substantially ( Zhi et al., 2026 ) ; users’ estimates of their own contribution shifted once they were shown goal-level traces of their conversations ( Kim et al., 2026a ) ; the cognitive forcing function that most reduced over-reliance on AI-generated plans was not the one participants found most helpful ( Ghosh et al., 2026 ) ; and experienced developers believed AI had sped them up when it had slowed them down ( Becker et al., 2025 ) (see also ( Fernandes et al., 2026 ; Buçinca et al., 2021 ) ). Offloading feels helpful precisely because it removes the effort that constitutes engagement ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Draxler et al., 2024 ) ; in co-writing research, support that improves the product can still feel less satisfying or less like one’s own ( Dhillon et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Draxler et al., 2024 ; Hwang et al., 2025 ; Joshi and Vogel, 2024 ; Heung and Chiu, 2025 ; Kirk and Givi, 2025 ) ; and dynamic controls demand inspection and choice even when they improve steering ( Drosos et al., 2025 ) . This suggests that studies evaluating AI’s impact on cognition, including system evaluations, should include objective measures of performance and cognitive processes ( Zhi et al., 2026 ; Zhi and Lee, 2026 ; Tankelevitch et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛地说，AI 辅助工作的主观测量与客观测量可能存在分歧，这本身就反映了元认知的局限。 这一模式在文献中反复出现：在实测表现差异悬殊的各条件之间，自评的批判性思维几乎没有变化（Zhi et al., 2026）；用户在看到其对话的目标层面轨迹后，对自身贡献的估计发生了变化（Kim et al., 2026a）；最能减少对 AI 生成计划过度依赖的认知强制机制，并非参与者认为最有用的那一个（Ghosh et al., 2026）；有经验的开发者在被 AI 拖慢时仍相信 AI 让他们变快了（Becker et al., 2025）（另见（Fernandes et al., 2026；Buçinca et al., 2021））。 卸载之所以让人感觉有帮助，恰恰是因为它去掉了构成投入的那种努力（Lee et al., 2025；Draxler et al., 2024）；在协同写作研究中，能改善成品的支持仍可能让人感觉不够满意、或 less 像出自自己之手（Dhillon et al., 2024；Li et al., 2024；Draxler et al., 2024；Hwang et al., 2025；Joshi and Vogel, 2024；Heung and Chiu, 2025；Kirk and Givi, 2025）；而动态控制即使在改善引导效果的同时，也要求用户进行查看与选择（Drosos et al., 2025）。 这表明，评估 AI 对认知影响的研究，包括系统评估，应当纳入对表现和认知过程的客观测量（Zhi et al., 2026；Zhi and Lee, 2026；Tankelevitch et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: A tool that feels less helpful is likely to be declined when it is optional: its benefits arrive only once the task is done, and often only in comparison with others’ work, which may never happen. Our data show how strong the pull toward the low-effort path is: despite a bonus for the best briefs, 119 of the 297 participants (40%) produced Task 2 prompt sequences that met the task-text copying criterion ( Figure 4 ), delegating not just production but the specification of the work itself. This may partly reflect our cohort, but it is also overreliance on AI in its most complete form ( Buçinca et al., 2021 ; Ghosh et al., 2026 ; Shaw and Nave, 2026 ) .The design challenge is to treat friction as a design material rather than a cost to be minimized ( Chen and Schmidt, 2024 ; Gould et al., 2021 ; Sheahan et al., 2024 ; Scott et al., 2025 ) , extending a long line of HCI research from microboundaries that interrupt automatic interaction to seamful designs that keep a system’s workings in view ( Cox et al., 2016 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一个让人感觉帮助不大的工具，在可选用的情况下很可能被拒绝使用：它的好处只有在任务完成后才会显现，而且往往只有在与他人工作的对比中才能体现，而这种对比可能永远不会发生。 我们的数据显示出低费力路径的吸引力有多强：尽管最佳简报有奖金奖励，297 名参与者中仍有 119 人（40%）产出了符合任务文本复制标准的任务 2 提示序列（图 4），不仅把产出外包出去，连工作本身的规格说明也一并交给了智能体。 这可能部分反映了我们的研究人群，但它也体现的是对人工智能最彻底形式的过度依赖（Buçinca et al., 2021；Ghosh et al., 2026；Shaw and Nave, 2026）。设计上的挑战在于把摩擦当作一种设计材料，而不是一个需要最小化的成本（Chen and Schmidt, 2024；Gould et al., 2021；Sheahan et al., 2024；Scott et al., 2025），从而延续人机交互研究的一条长线传统——从打断自动化交互的微观边界，到让系统运作保持可见的接缝式设计（Cox et al., 2016）。

paragraphs.en: Not all friction is productive, however. Although we designed our scaffold to be supportive, participants’ open-ended comments after Task 1, which we did not analyze systematically, are suggestive. The clearest theme was the cost of specifying everything up front “in a short time to meet requirements”. This aligns with Zhi et al. (2026) : the cognitive benefits of independently structuring a task in an AI-assisted workflow requires sufficient time. A related point was the need for “more time to learn how to use it effectively”, which also affected participants “ownership of the writing”. A second theme was that choosing between goals itself demands expertise, for example “prioritising being persuasive or using emotional appeal”–this is partly a limitation of the simulated nature of our task. Finally, another concern was the gap between control over planning and control over revision, such as simple document-wide corrections and ways to “lock” sentences. One participant valued the planning support but desired “options to refine what I had done first time”. These comments point to scaffolds that stage specification across the draft rather than front-loading it, that explain the choices they ask for, and that pair metacognitive support for planning with support for revision ( Kazemitabaar et al., 2024b ; Kim et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，并非所有摩擦都是有益的。 尽管我们设计的支架意在提供支持，但参与者在任务1之后的开放式评论（我们并未对其进行系统分析）仍具有启发性。 最清晰的主题是“在短时间内满足要求”而预先指定所有内容的代价。 这与 Zhi 等人的研究一致。 （2026）：在AI辅助工作流中独立构建任务结构所带来的认知收益需要充足的时间。 一个相关的观点是需要“更多时间来学习如何有效使用它”，这也影响了参与者“对写作的所有权”。 第二个主题是在目标之间做出选择本身就需要专业知识，例如“在追求说服力还是运用情感诉求之间进行权衡”——这在一定程度上是我们模拟任务性质的局限性。 最后，另一个关注点是规划控制与修订控制之间的差距，例如简单的全文修改以及“锁定”句子的方式。 一位参与者重视规划支持，但希望有“选项来完善我第一次完成的内容”。 这些评论指向的支架应当把规格说明分阶段地分布在草稿过程中而非前置集中，应当解释它们所要求的选择，并且应当将对规划的元认知支持与对修订的支持相结合（Kazemitabaar et al., 2024b; Kim et al., 2026b）。

paragraphs.en: More generally, showing the seams of breaking the task down should be part of producing work that one can stand behind and will remember, rather than an obstacle the AI has imposed ( Li et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2023 ; Kirk and Givi, 2025 ) . This requires making the value legible at three points where it is easy to miss: (a) in the moment, so that instructing and steering the AI carries its own payoff, experienced as thinking by doing rather than as friction before the ‘real work’ begins; (b) across the workflow, so that the structure a scaffold imposes is seen to pay off as work moves from one phase to the next rather than registering only as an upfront cost; and (c) in the outcome, so that people can recognize how a result was achieved and feed that recognition into the next piece of work.
paragraphs.zh: 更宽泛地说，展示任务拆解的“接缝”应当成为产出值得信赖且令人印象深刻的工作的一部分，而不是智能体强加的障碍（Li et al., 2024；He et al., 2023；Kirk and Givi, 2025）。 这就要求在三个容易被忽视的环节上让这一价值清晰可见：（a）在当下，使得指导和引导智能体本身就带来回报，被体验为“在做中思考”，而非“真正工作”开始前的摩擦；（b）在整个工作流程中，使得脚手架所施加的结构在工作从一个阶段推进到下一个阶段时显出成效，而不只是被记为一笔先期成本；（c）在成果中，使得人们能够识别结果是如何达成的，并将这种认识带入下一项工作。

sents.en: This requires making the value legible at three points where it is easy to miss: (a) in the moment, so that instructing and steering the AI carries its own payoff, experienced as thinking by doing rather than as friction before the ‘real work’ begins; (b) across the workflow, so that the structure a scaffold imposes is seen to pay off as work moves from one phase to the next rather than registering only as an upfront cost; and (c) in the outcome, so that people can recognize how a result was achieved and feed that recognition into the next piece of work.
sents.zh: 这就要求在三个容易被忽视的环节上让这一价值清晰可见：（a）在当下，使得指导和引导智能体本身就带来回报，被体验为“在做中思考”，而非“真正工作”开始前的摩擦；（b）在整个工作流程中，使得脚手架所施加的结构在工作从一个阶段推进到下一个阶段时显出成效，而不只是被记为一笔先期成本；（c）在成果中，使得人们能够识别结果是如何达成的，并将这种认识带入下一项工作。

paragraphs.en: These findings should be read against a rapidly moving frontier. It is tempting to assume that more capable agentic systems will simply absorb goal-setting and decomposition. But as autonomous task horizons lengthen ( Kwa et al., 2025 ) , a single instruction sets off longer chains of action, and human involvement shrinks to fewer, higher-stakes moments of specifying and verifying what the system produces ( Sarkar, 2026 ; Passi, 2025 ; Dhanorkar et al., 2026 ) . What most remains with the person, and what they are most anxious to keep, is the understanding and direction of the work itself ( Shao et al., 2025 ) . The socio-technical problem is thus to design for the regulation of work as much as its generation: for the disposition that an AI system can cultivate in a person , with scaffolds that fade as the relevant skills are internalized ( Molenaar, 2022 ; Tankelevitch et al., 2024 ) . Here that means specifying goals, breaking work into checkable parts, and eliciting both from whatever system is at hand, so that tools leave workers more capable as and when AI systems change or are unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现应当结合一个快速演进的前沿领域来解读。 人们很容易想当然地认为，能力更强的智能体系统会自然而然地掌握目标设定与任务分解。 但随着自主任务的时间跨度不断延长（Kwa et al., 2025），一条指令会触发更长的行动链条，人类参与则缩减为更少但更关键的节点，即 specifying（明确）和 verifying（验证）系统产出（Sarkar, 2026; Passi, 2025; Dhanorkar et al., 2026）。 人所保留最多的、也是他们最希望保住的，是对工作本身的理解与方向把控（Shao et al., 2025）。 因此，这一社会技术问题的核心在于，对工作的“调控”与“生成”要并重设计：即设计 AI 系统能在人身上培养出的那种素质（disposition），并辅以随相关技能内化而逐步撤除的支架（scaffold）（Molenaar, 2022; Tankelevitch et al., 2024）。 这意味着明确目标、将工作拆解为可核查的组成部分，并从手头可用的任何系统中引出这些能力，以便在 AI 系统变更或不可用时，工具仍能让工作者变得更有能力。

paragraphs.en: A key limitation is the LLM judge. Firstly, there is a possible bias toward structure rather than content. However, the judge found a smaller treatment advantage than human raters who saw the formatted essays ( Table 2 ), providing little evidence that structure inflated the primary estimate. The 107-essay benchmark adds a useful comparison of rating approaches on the same essays, with human ratings supporting an advantage in both tasks and the judge’s composite estimates pointing in the same direction. Its smaller size limits precision, and its between-subjects comparisons address the advantage within each task; evidence concerning persistence within individuals comes from the full-corpus analysis. Secondly, the judge’s ‘conservatism’ is defined relative to human-perceived quality, which itself incorporates presentation, so we have no ‘structure-free’ benchmark. Thirdly, agreement with human ratings was moreover moderate rather than strong, and the judge compressed the human score range (calibration slope = 0.375 =0.375 ; Table A8 ). The essay-quality result should therefore be read together with the prompting, metacognitive self-report and recall evidence, which do not depend on the judge and converge on the same conclusion.
paragraphs.zh: 一个关键局限在于 LLM 评审。 首先，可能存在偏向结构而非内容的偏差。 然而，评审所发现的治疗优势小于看到格式化文章的人类评分者（表 2），几乎没有证据表明结构夸大了主要估计值。 107 篇文章的基准为在同一批文章上比较不同评分方式提供了有用的对照，人类评分支持两项任务中的优势，而评审的综合估计也指向同一方向。 其较小的规模限制了精确度，且其被试间比较考察的是每项任务内部的优势；关于个体内部持续性的证据来自全语料库分析。 其次，评审的“保守性”是相对于人类感知质量定义的，而人类感知质量本身已包含呈现因素，因此我们不存在“无结构”的基准。 第三，评审与人类评分的一致性仅为中等而非强，且评审压缩了人类评分的范围（校准斜率 =0.375；表 A8）。 因此，文章质量的结果应与提示、元认知自我报告及回忆的证据结合起来解读，后者不依赖于评审，并收敛于同一结论。

paragraphs.en: Another limitation concerns our recall analysis. Both contrasts underlying the recall effect were positive across analyses, but the confidence intervals were wide ( Table A10 ), so the data are compatible with anything from a small to a large effect. Recall was also scored under a lenient rule that credited any correct topic identification, a deliberately low bar that leaves open whether the effect extends to deeper understanding or retention of essay content. Follow-up attrition was substantial (50.6% of participants in the recall cohort had no scored recall outcome). Although attrition is expected in an online sample, it introduces potential for sample biases that limit interpretation and generalizability. Treatment did not predict missingness, whereas other observed factors did, and the complete-case and multiple-imputation analyses agree, which limits the risk of bias in the treatment contrast. However, we can only rule out dependence on what we measured. Finally, topic recall is a narrow index of cognitive engagement, which also involves critical thinking about material ( Zhi et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) and communicating about work with collaborators ( Riedl et al., 2026 ) ; future work should use tasks that require evaluating and integrating source material ( Zhi et al., 2026 ) and communicating outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个局限涉及我们的回忆分析。 构成回忆效应的两个对比在各项分析中均为正值，但置信区间较宽（表 A10），因此数据与从小效应到大效应的任何情况都相容。 回忆还采用了一种宽松规则进行评分，即只要正确识别出主题即得分，这是一个刻意设置的低门槛，使得该效应是否延伸到对文章内容的更深理解或保持仍属未知。 后续随访流失较为严重（回忆队列中 50.6% 的参与者没有可评分的回忆结果）。 尽管在线样本中出现流失在所难免，但它引入了样本偏差的可能性，从而限制了解释和推广性。 处理条件并不能预测缺失，而其他可观测因素则可以，并且完整案例分析或多重插补分析的结果一致，这降低了处理对比中出现偏差的风险。 然而，我们只能排除对已测量因素的依赖。 最后，主题回忆只是认知参与的一个狭窄指标，认知参与还包括对材料的批判性思考（Zhi et al., 2026；Lee et al., 2025）以及与协作者就工作进行交流（Riedl et al., 2026）；未来研究应使用需要评估和整合原始材料（Zhi et al., 2026）并交流产出的任务。
